initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.4, but arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R290-2 establishes randomized assignment independent of potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference. These identify the causal risk difference as P(Y=1|X=1) − P(Y=1|X=0) = 1/10 − 20/40 = -0.4.
